# CLI reference

Recording and config commands accept `--config PATH` to read one explicit YAML file.
Explicit flags override file values only when provided. Status and snapshot use the
running daemon through its control socket and do not reload that file. See
[configuration](configuration.md) for precedence, validation and resource budgets.
`--help` is available on every command; `--version` and `version` print the
application build version.

## Global flags

Recording settings belong to `daemon` and `capture`. The socket is a CLI-only
endpoint choice for `daemon`, `status`, and `snapshot`; timeout is also a YAML
setting. Offline analysis only needs presentation options. `config check` and
`config show` accept YAML setting overrides for validation.

| Flag | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--color` | `auto` | terminal colors: auto, always, never |

## `blackbox analyze`

Analyze a capture offline without root or eBPF.

```sh
blackbox analyze FILE.bbx
```

| Flag | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | `false` | emit the complete deterministic report as JSON |
| `--verbose` | `false` | include lifetime diagnostics and expanded event/process limits |

## `blackbox capture`

Record a new window without an existing daemon.

```sh
blackbox capture
```

| Flag | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--block-io-critical` | `250ms` | Critical I/O threshold. Example: 250ms. |
| `--block-io-warn` | `50ms` | Slow I/O threshold. Example: 50ms. |
| `--config` | `` | explicit YAML configuration file (no implicit discovery) |
| `--duration` | `30s` | new recording window (sets retained history for this run) |
| `--log-level` | `info` | Daemon log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error. Logs go to stderr. |
| `--max-memory` | `32MiB` | Retained history budget: 1MiB–1GiB (B, KiB, MiB, GiB). Total process memory also includes queues, Go runtime and snapshot work; kernel maps are separate. |
| `--output, -o` | `` | destination (default: generated in the current directory; must not exist) |
| `--poll-interval` | `1s` | How often to collect sensor totals: 100ms–1m, no longer than history. Shorter intervals improve time resolution and increase polling work. |
| `--scheduler-critical` | `100ms` | Critical runnable wait threshold. Example: 100ms. |
| `--scheduler-warn` | `20ms` | Slow runnable wait threshold. Example: 20ms. |
| `--sensors` | `[block_io,scheduler,tcp,oom]` | Enabled sensors: block_io, scheduler, tcp, oom. Choose one or more; no duplicates. |
| `--strict` | `false` | false: continue with available sensors and report missing coverage. true: fail startup or stop recording if any enabled sensor fails permanently. |

## `blackbox config`

Validate or print effective configuration.

```sh
blackbox config
```

## `blackbox config check`

Validate merged settings without root or kernel access.

```sh
blackbox config check
```

| Flag | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--auto-capture-after` | `10s` | Post-detection window: 0s–24h. Triggers in the first window do not extend it. |
| `--auto-capture-before` | `1m` | Requested history before first detection: 1s–24h. If history is shorter, coverage is partial. |
| `--auto-capture-directory` | `/var/lib/blackbox/captures/auto` | Private absolute directory for automatic files. Oldest automatic files rotate within both limits. |
| `--auto-capture-enabled` | `true` | true: save incidents automatically; false: manual snapshots only. |
| `--auto-capture-max-files` | `1000` | Maximum published automatic files: 1–10000. Manual captures are not rotated. |
| `--auto-capture-max-storage` | `1GiB` | Published automatic file budget: 1MiB–1TiB (B/KiB/MiB/GiB). A staged replacement briefly needs extra disk space. |
| `--auto-capture-sensors` | `[block_io,scheduler,oom]` | Trigger sources: block_io, scheduler (critical latency), oom (victim count). Only enabled, available recording sensors participate. TCP is not supported. |
| `--auto-capture-write-timeout` | `2m` | Deadline for persisting one automatic incident: 1s–10m. Independent of local control requests. |
| `--block-io-critical` | `250ms` | Critical I/O threshold. Example: 250ms. |
| `--block-io-warn` | `50ms` | Slow I/O threshold. Example: 50ms. |
| `--config` | `` | explicit YAML configuration file (no implicit discovery) |
| `--history` | `5m` | Rolling history to keep: 1s–24h. Examples: 30s, 5m, 1h. |
| `--log-level` | `info` | Daemon log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error. Logs go to stderr. |
| `--max-memory` | `32MiB` | Retained history budget: 1MiB–1GiB (B, KiB, MiB, GiB). Total process memory also includes queues, Go runtime and snapshot work; kernel maps are separate. |
| `--poll-interval` | `1s` | How often to collect sensor totals: 100ms–1m, no longer than history. Shorter intervals improve time resolution and increase polling work. |
| `--scheduler-critical` | `100ms` | Critical runnable wait threshold. Example: 100ms. |
| `--scheduler-warn` | `20ms` | Slow runnable wait threshold. Example: 20ms. |
| `--sensors` | `[block_io,scheduler,tcp,oom]` | Enabled sensors: block_io, scheduler, tcp, oom. Choose one or more; no duplicates. |
| `--strict` | `false` | false: continue with available sensors and report missing coverage. true: fail startup or stop recording if any enabled sensor fails permanently. |
| `--timeout` | `30s` | Maximum local control request/snapshot duration: 1s–10m. Examples: 30s, 1m. |

## `blackbox daemon`

Record bounded history in the foreground.

```sh
blackbox daemon
```

| Flag | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--auto-capture-after` | `10s` | Post-detection window: 0s–24h. Triggers in the first window do not extend it. |
| `--auto-capture-before` | `1m` | Requested history before first detection: 1s–24h. If history is shorter, coverage is partial. |
| `--auto-capture-directory` | `/var/lib/blackbox/captures/auto` | Private absolute directory for automatic files. Oldest automatic files rotate within both limits. |
| `--auto-capture-enabled` | `true` | true: save incidents automatically; false: manual snapshots only. |
| `--auto-capture-max-files` | `1000` | Maximum published automatic files: 1–10000. Manual captures are not rotated. |
| `--auto-capture-max-storage` | `1GiB` | Published automatic file budget: 1MiB–1TiB (B/KiB/MiB/GiB). A staged replacement briefly needs extra disk space. |
| `--auto-capture-sensors` | `[block_io,scheduler,oom]` | Trigger sources: block_io, scheduler (critical latency), oom (victim count). Only enabled, available recording sensors participate. TCP is not supported. |
| `--auto-capture-write-timeout` | `2m` | Deadline for persisting one automatic incident: 1s–10m. Independent of local control requests. |
| `--block-io-critical` | `250ms` | Critical I/O threshold. Example: 250ms. |
| `--block-io-warn` | `50ms` | Slow I/O threshold. Example: 50ms. |
| `--config` | `` | explicit YAML configuration file (no implicit discovery) |
| `--history` | `5m` | Rolling history to keep: 1s–24h. Examples: 30s, 5m, 1h. |
| `--log-level` | `info` | Daemon log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error. Logs go to stderr. |
| `--max-memory` | `32MiB` | Retained history budget: 1MiB–1GiB (B, KiB, MiB, GiB). Total process memory also includes queues, Go runtime and snapshot work; kernel maps are separate. |
| `--poll-interval` | `1s` | How often to collect sensor totals: 100ms–1m, no longer than history. Shorter intervals improve time resolution and increase polling work. |
| `--scheduler-critical` | `100ms` | Critical runnable wait threshold. Example: 100ms. |
| `--scheduler-warn` | `20ms` | Slow runnable wait threshold. Example: 20ms. |
| `--sensors` | `[block_io,scheduler,tcp,oom]` | Enabled sensors: block_io, scheduler, tcp, oom. Choose one or more; no duplicates. |
| `--socket` | `/run/blackbox/blackbox.sock` | Private daemon socket. Absolute Unix path, at most 103 bytes. Keep the default unless running multiple daemons; clients must use the same path. |
| `--strict` | `false` | false: continue with available sensors and report missing coverage. true: fail startup or stop recording if any enabled sensor fails permanently. |
| `--timeout` | `30s` | Maximum local control request/snapshot duration: 1s–10m. Examples: 30s, 1m. |

## `blackbox snapshot`

Freeze previous history into a private .bbx file.

```sh
blackbox snapshot
```

| Flag | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--last` | `0s` | previous duration to freeze (unset: daemon history; older daemon: configured history) |
| `--output, -o` | `` | destination (default: generated in the current directory; must not exist) |
| `--socket` | `/run/blackbox/blackbox.sock` | Private daemon socket. Absolute Unix path, at most 103 bytes. Keep the default unless running multiple daemons; clients must use the same path. |
| `--timeout` | `30s` | Maximum local control request/snapshot duration: 1s–10m. Examples: 30s, 1m. |

## `blackbox status`

Show recorder health and missing coverage.

```sh
blackbox status
```

| Flag | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | `false` | emit JSON health |
| `--socket` | `/run/blackbox/blackbox.sock` | Private daemon socket. Absolute Unix path, at most 103 bytes. Keep the default unless running multiple daemons; clients must use the same path. |
| `--timeout` | `30s` | Maximum local control request/snapshot duration: 1s–10m. Examples: 30s, 1m. |
| `--verbose` | `false` | show all lifetime diagnostics |

## `blackbox version`

Show the application build version.

```sh
blackbox version
```
